commits.summary: feature-loop.sh: a relational loop that improves relational verification, with examples
feature-loop.sh: lower the default memory cap from 4G to 3.5G
Regression proofs share the callees both versions call unchanged, and skip a target whose bytecode is identical (verification pending)
Regression proofs across a signature change: the previous version named and called with expressions over the new parameters (verification pending)
Regression proofs under a stated relation between the results: a result that changed its type or meaning is related to the previous one with --results-agree-when (verification pending)
The tool's own checker looks for a violating input in JBMC's stages, so its witnesses read as JBMC's; examples 124 and 125 run regression proofs through it (verification pending)
Record verification results for 10 jobs: two Quorum reruns pass, eight B12 examples fail on a result.json schema mismatch

Regression proofs on a record's components: a method of a record, or one taking or returning a record of primitives, is proved with the record built from symbolic components in both versions; examples 126 and 127 on a new backoff kernel (verification pending)

Regression proofs relate a record result whose components changed, or a result that became a record, by a relation over the components; examples 134 and 135 on a new window-counter kernel of Crosscut (verification pending)

The tool's own checker leaves a multiplication to the solver under cheap facts and rewrites a quotient times its divisor as the dividend less the remainder; examples 138 and 139 on the window start as the window's index times its length (verification pending)
Record verification results for 35 jobs: examples 111-120, 124, 125, 132, 133 pass; 21 B9 jobs fail on tool or patch mismatches, not verdicts

The pipeline builds jvmcontract from each job's own lib/ instead of reusing the last binary, and build.py takes the excerpt of a method moved out of a deleted file; 26 B9 jobs resubmitted (verification pending)
Record verification results for 26 resubmitted B9 jobs: 24 pass, 128 and 129 fail because the patch no longer applies to Tests.java
Examples 128 and 129's patches apply again: their Tests.java hunk rebased past WindowTest; both resubmitted (verification pending)
Example 036's patch regenerated on the current SwitchLowering.java, so it applies again (verification pending)
Record verification results for 3 jobs: examples 128, 129 and 036 give their expected verdicts
